name: orphan
description: A leaf with no parent at all, alongside a leaf with an important parent and the same own importance. The most likely shape to crash naive propagation code.

nodes.label: Leaf with no parent, same own importance as task_with_parent

notes: Same own importance (0.4) for both -- task_with_parent gets a boost from goal_root, task_orphan has no ancestry to boost it and stays at its own baseline. Must not crash or raise just because parent_task_id is null; null is the normal, expected case for a root-level task, not an error. The stated order assumes a combination model where a parent can only raise a descendant's score relative to having no parent, never lower it below the descendant's own baseline -- under a multiplicative model (0.4*0.9=0.36) task_with_parent would score below task_orphan's bare 0.4, reversing this order. That's a stated assumption for this fixture, not a claim about the real formula; #474 hasn't decided the actual combination yet.
